notes: The first לְ is unrepresented because the ASV writes *called the people* with a bare object (rule 40); the assimilated article beside it still takes its *the* under rule 12, and the second לְ carries *unto*.
אֱלֹהֵיהֶן is read twice on its own terms: as rectum of זִבְחֵי it takes the relational *of* (rule 19), while the coordinate לֵאלֹהֵיהֶן phrase writes no *of* and the noun keeps only *gods*.
